chapter: Edgar Blanchard, Danny White and spot jobbing
title: Danny White's pianist Leonard Truje and the end of the Edgar years
summary: Cotton recalls Leonard Truje and Charles Easley, that the party record was his only recording with Edgar, and about four or five years with the band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, that's what it was. I mean, yeah. It was catered to whites, tourists and all of them. The tourists and everybody else. We played. But you know, that's all we did, we played. We just had to perform. Let me see, I played that with Danny White too. Okay, because you had to know Danny. Yeah, and then later on when Truje, he was a piano player for Danny White. Now he was a pharmacy. While he was gone with Danny's band, he went to Xavier College to become a pharmacist in his spare time and he became
a pharmacist. What was his first name? Leonard. Leonard Truje. Okay, I've heard the name but I didn't know.

Yeah, Leonard Truje, yeah. He lives over in Slidell somewhere I think. But anyway, when Leonard left and I went in the band, but Charles Easley was playing bass when I went in the band, the other fellas, the same people were there. That must have been a hot band. I mean, that

must have been fabulously. Did you make any other recordings in this party record? I know Edgar made some other recordings about this time. No, that's only... That's the only one you remember? That's the only one I remember. Because there was someone that he did some recordings with Specialty.
Oh yeah, yeah, he did quite a few things with him. But I was not with him. You weren't with him then? No. The only record recording I made with Edgar was with this thing here.
Was his party record? His party record that I can't remember. It's someplace but it's in

a vault somewhere and somebody has it. Somebody has it but I never even got a copy. I was supposed to have gotten a copy but I didn't even get a copy. So I don't even know where Lonzo White died, he died. I don't know where his children are. I don't know if they even have a copy of it or not. But nevertheless, I do remember that.
